rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes reducing nozzle-to-substrate distance to increase particle velocity, while the paper's actual intervention was selecting the medium air/fuel-pressure setting on the HVAF-i7 torch. Both aim to improve deposition, but the hypothesis changes a geometric parameter (standoff) whereas the paper changed a process gas parameter (air/fuel pressure). This is the same kind of intervention (HVAF-i7 process parameter adjustment) but a different specific lever.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis mentions propylene-fueled low-temperature HVAF-i7, spraying into 120 mm internal diameters, and high-temperature oxidation service. The paper used the same torch and fuel, preheated substrates to 155 °C, and performed isothermal oxidation at 1000–1150 °C. The hypothesis lacks the paper's specific preheat temperature and exact oxidation conditions but captures the same broad regime.
